Download the App. Managing your pet’s care has never been easier. Our easy-to-use mobile app puts the entire Queen City Pet Sitting experience right in the palm of your hand. ​You can schedule or adjust pet care visits directly from your phone, whether you need a daily dog walk, a last-minute visit, or extended overnight care. During each visit, you’ll receive real-time updates, photos, and detailed notes so you always know how your pet is doing. Our sitters check in and out using GPS tracking, giving you complete peace of mind. Plus, you can message our team anytime through the app — no waiting on emails or calls. Everything from scheduling to communication is streamlined, secure, and designed around your convenience. Download the Time to Pet App for Android or iPhone and experience truly stress-free, reliable pet sitting and dog walking in Charlotte, NC — wherever you are. Trusted Pet Sitters Who Treat Your Pets Like Family When you invite someone into your home, trust matters. That’s why all of our sitters are thoroughly vetted, background-checked, and committed to maintaining cleanliness and professionalism.We go above and beyond — from scooping and cleaning up after your pets to sending photo updates during every visit. You’ll always come home to a happy pet and a spotless home. Why Choose Queen City Pet Sitting? We’re not just another nationwide app — we’re locally owned and operated right here in Charlotte, NC. Our hand-selected team of sitters and walkers are long-time residents who genuinely care about our community’s pets. When you choose Queen City Pet Sitting, you’re getting the perfect balance of personalized, small-business service with the convenience of modern technology. Through our Time to Pet App, you can easily schedule visits, message your sitter, and receive real-time updates with GPS tracking, photos, and visit summaries.Our clients love the peace of mind that comes from knowing their pets are cared for by professionals who treat them like family — and many of our customers have trusted us for over a decade. How to Get Started Fill out our form to request service Our management team will contact you personally to confirm your needs We’ll pair you with a trusted pet sitter who will then contact you directly to set up a time for the in-home meet & greet. Your sitter will send you real time updates with photos during each visit via our online portal & mobile app.
